meaning: Symbolic discussion board for the runthrough. Plans, the mons they use, the costs they pay, the conditions and threats that decide them, alternatives, and checks. Which opposing matchups a plan concedes is the user's choice and stays undecided until selected. Status says where each claim stands; there is no strength score.

statuses.hypothesis: Proposed from exploration (E1, E2, E6) or reasoning; not checked.
statuses.engine_checked: Executed in the pinned Showdown engine under controlled choices (workbench/RUNTHROUGH_CHECK.md, workbench/runthrough/summary.json). Shows a mechanism executes, not that it wins.
statuses.native_checked: Native Smogon Champions calculator result, stored with inputs (workbench/board/checks/).
statuses.rejected: Checked and ruled out; kept for history.

plans.title: Gholdengo Memento into Contrary Mega Staraptor
plans.summary: Memento's -2 Atk / -2 SpA becomes +2 / +2 on Contrary Mega Staraptor; Gholdengo faints and is replaced after the turn. The pair is already common; the Memento line is not.

uses.role: enabler: uses Memento on its ally
receiver: Contrary turns the drops into boosts

conditions.text: Ally Memento raises Contrary Mega Staraptor to +2 Atk / +2 SpA and Gholdengo faints
With the tested spreads (Timid 32-Speed Gholdengo, Jolly 32-Speed Staraptor), Staraptor attacks before Memento, so +2 starts on its second attack
Choice Scarf Gholdengo uses Memento before Staraptor's attack, so +2 applies on turn one
Opposing Follow Me (tested: Clefable) redirects Memento; Gholdengo faints and Staraptor gets nothing
Opposing Rage Powder should redirect it the same way (Gholdengo is not Grass and not powder-immune)
Ordinary Fake Out cannot hit Ghost-type Gholdengo (Memento still lands); base Scrappy Kangaskhan's Fake Out flinches it

Among nine selected targets, using each target's better move: +2 turns Garchomp, Kingambit, Pelipper and Basculegion into guaranteed OHKOs; Rillaboom, Sneasler, Incineroar and Archaludon are already OHKO at +0; Gholdengo goes 3HKO to 2HKO

targets.why: Close Combat 37.5% to OHKO at +0, guaranteed at +2
Opposing Gholdengo: Brave Bird 3HKO at +0, 2HKO at +2

threats.name: Follow Me
threats.effect: Steals Memento; Gholdengo faints for nothing (tested with Clefable)

threats.name: Rage Powder
threats.effect: Should steal Memento the same way

plans.verdict: Undecided; depends on the user's targets. If the team must beat Garchomp, Kingambit, Pelipper or Basculegion, +2 changes those KOs. Unscarfed, the boost lands on turn two; the Scarf version is same-turn. Follow Me spends Gholdengo for nothing.

costs.why: Donor faints to deliver the boost; its slot is spent

plans.concessions: undecided: the user selects which opposing matchups this plan gives up

plans.title: Whimsicott Prankster Memento into Mega Staraptor
plans.summary: Whimsicott learns Memento and has Prankster, so Memento should go first. Unlike Gholdengo, it ignores Rage Powder as a Grass type; Follow Me still applies.

conditions.text: Prankster gives ally-targeted Memento priority, so +2 applies on turn one
Follow Me should still redirect Whimsicott's Memento
Rage Powder does not: Whimsicott is Grass type, and Grass types are immune to powder redirection

plans.verdict: Worth a test: needs an engine run of Prankster Memento onto the ally.

costs.why: Gives up its own Tailwind turn and faints

plans.concessions: undecided: the user selects which opposing matchups this plan gives up

plans.title: Simple Beam Snorlax, Psych Up into Mega Slowbro
plans.summary: Base Audino Simple Beams Snorlax; three Stockpiles under Simple reach +6 Def / +6 SpD; Slowbro copies them with Psych Up and Mega Evolves for Shell Armor; Body Press is the intended attack. Executed in the engine over four turns with opponents choosing Protect throughout. Found independently by E6's path search.

uses.role: booster: Stockpile under Simple; can also Body Press
receiver: Psych Up, then Mega Evolve for Shell Armor; Body Press / Stored Power

conditions.text: Base Audino supplies Simple Beam; Mega Evolving Audino makes Slowbro's later Mega choice illegal
conditions.evidence: workbench/RUNTHROUGH_CHECK.md (Audino / Snorlax / Slowbro chain); workbench/runthrough/summary.json branches[name=base-audino-chain]

conditions.text: Three Stockpiles under Simple reach +6 Def / +6 SpD
Psych Up copies +6 / +6 onto Slowbro, which keeps them through Mega Evolution
Setup survives real pressure over four turns: untested (the executed trace had opponents Protect every turn)
At +6 / +6 the strongest top-10 hit (Life Orb Gholdengo Shadow Ball) does 27.2-32.1%, a guaranteed 4HKO
Body Press with the usage spread (0 Def points): Rillaboom 123.7-145.7% OHKO, Incineroar 216.8-255.4% OHKO, Sneasler 75% to OHKO

threats.name: Encore
threats.effect: Locks the setup (Encore on 69% of Whimsicott sets)

threats.name: Haze / Clear Smog / Unaware
threats.effect: No top-60 species runs these on 10% or more of its sets

plans.verdict: Mechanism executes; viability unknown. Survival and payoff thresholds pass on a neutral field, but the four setup turns were only tested against Protect.

costs.why: A support slot whose job ends after Simple Beam
